items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: They're all dead, I guess, in the Martin family.

ctx.x: Oh, one other question, too, while I think of it, uh, Coochie Martin, which band was your father playing in at that time? Do you remember, was that, did Coochie Martin play with Robichoke too? I don't remember much about it. No.
They're all dead, I guess, in the Martin family. There was a band that was named Onfrey and Duran.
